text:
maya: ping for a quick UX check on run history rows when a tool call returns structured output. deciding on collapsed copy, pill labeling, and SR ordering.

ravi: paste the mocks pls.

maya: collapsed: `UserProfile (Schema) · 5 fields · auth_service` with a small gray pill `structured`. Expanded: heading `UserProfile`, key/value grid, tabs `Preview` and `Raw`.

olga: Pill copy `structured` is inconsistent. Suggest `Schema` (sentence case) + braces icon. Also contrast tweak on bg color.

ravi: For collapsed announce order, SR should read: heading, type, source, count. So `UserProfile, Schema, from auth_service, 5 fields`.

maya: Good. For compact rows, show icon-only pill with tooltip and `aria-label`. Hit area must be 44x44.

olga: For expanded table, use `role=table`, headers with scope, and ensure Enter/Space opens row, Esc closes.

design-bot: Generated figma previews: https://figma.redwood.team/s/PLAYGROUND-SCHEMA-2471112222

maya: Plan: change pill to `Schema`, collapsed copy `UserProfile (Schema) · auth_service.getUser()` (signature truncated), tabs `Formatted` / `Raw JSON`, add aria-describedby for full signature. Tests: keyboard nav, NVDA/VoiceOver, tooltip SR text, contrast snapshot.

ravi: Looks good. No more comments.
